steps.line: Hi! I'm Momo. Come on, I'll walk you through Ronak's world.
It began with C++ and Codeforces — then straight into backend.
Watch this — his whole life, fast-forward. I'll grow up with it!
Best part — real systems. Go, Node, queues that never sleep.
1,200-plus contributions this year. He never rests!
157 words a minute. I can't even type that fast with paws.
Want it on paper? The résumé's right down here.
